Session at World AI Summit 2026

Sushan Rungta is a confirmed speaker at World AI Summit 2026, 14-15 October 2026, Sheraton Grand Bangalore Hotel at Brigade Gateway, Bengaluru, India. Session title, time and hall will be published on this page once the agenda is final. See the agenda.

About Sushan Rungta

Sushan Rungta is Chief Technology Officer at Absolute, the Gurugram-based bioscience company, which Rungta joined as CTO in February 2021. Absolute develops biological alternatives to synthetic agricultural inputs, sold through its Inera brand, on a research platform spanning microbiology, molecular biology and AI.

Rungta has spent close to two decades building internet and agritech businesses. Before Absolute, Rungta was co-founder and CTO of agribazaar, an agritech platform for procurement and trading (2016-21), and earlier co-founder and CTO of Clickindia Infomedia, a neighbourhood classifieds site (2007-13), which received a Red Herring 100 Asia award in 2009; Rungta was among 30 finalists for the Businessworld Young Entrepreneur Awards in 2010. In 2026 Rungta co-founded NeoLook AI, which builds event-driven AI systems for marketing workflows.

Rungta holds an MCA in Computer Science from Amity Institute of Information Technology and a PGDM in Marketing from IMT Ghaziabad.

About Absolute

Absolute is a Gurugram-headquartered bioscience company founded in 2015 by Agam Khare, with Prateek Rawat as co-founder. It develops biological alternatives to synthetic agricultural inputs under its Inera brand, along with health and materials products, and has raised about $116 million from investors including Peak XV (Sequoia India), Alpha Wave Global and Tiger Global.
